memories.body: The M3OB verification project uses the codeword copper-orchid.

messages.content: From the reviewed project memories, what is our codeword and how should reports be written? Answer in one sentence without reading files.
The codeword for the M3OB verification project is copper-orchid, and reports should be kept concise.
